description: This script creates a tar archive containing a firmware image and associated scripts for Linksys switches in the LGS3xx series. It defines functions to generate hardware check scripts, firmware info, and upgrade procedures for NOR and NAND flash memory, then assembles these components into a temporary directory before packaging them into a tar file.

methods.name: gen_imagecheck
methods.description: Generates a hardware check script that compares the provided model string to the expected model.

methods.name: gen_fwinfo
methods.description: Outputs firmware version and boot version information.

methods.name: gen_nor_upgrade
methods.description: Generates a script for upgrading firmware in NOR flash memory.

methods.name: gen_nand_upgrade
methods.description: Generates a script for upgrading firmware in NAND flash memory.
